senses.gloss: f. pl. (v. next w.) enough for a meal in the household.
units: Erub. 82ᵇ תרתי רִיפָתָא א׳ Ms. M. (ed. איכרייתא, Asheri, ed. Ven. כברייתא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) two large loaves of the household (or of mourners’ meals). [Rashi, expl. our w. as loaves of drivers of oxen, appears to have had before him the vers. of Ms. M. and to derive our w. from ברא, v. בַּר I a. אֲפַר.]
